item.text: {"question_id":"5B.5","answer":"Resistance to economic capture was weak and inconsistent during the 2023 period. The administration’s institutional environment showed substantial procurement risks: 38% of federal procurement spending was directly awarded, 25% of tenders had three or fewer participants, 45% of purchases were published after contract start, and contracts included sanctioned or newly created suppliers; medicine procurement was 74% direct award and Diconsa awarded 90% of its 19.734 billion pesos in purchases directly (BATCH-0045-E004; BATCH-0045-E005). These are systemic risk indicators rather than proof that López Obrador personally selected suppliers or benefited. Segalmex, an agency created by his government, accumulated audit irregularities reported at 15.151 billion pesos for 2019–2021, with investigations and complaints; cooperation with the ASF and criminal complaints were undertaken by Segalmex officials and the ASF, not shown as the president’s personal cooperation (BATCH-0007-E003; BATCH-0011-E001; BATCH-0046-E008). The government did remove Ignacio Ovalle after the allegations but reassigned him to another government post; the evidence does not establish that this was a deliberate refusal to remedy capture, nor does it establish presidential personal direction of the alleged misconduct (BATCH-0046-E008). Independent assessments found absent high-level corruption prosecutions, inadequate enforcement, unreliable beneficial-ownership information, and politicized or selective enforcement involving allies and favored institutions (BATCH-0016-E021; BATCH-0003-E019; BATCH-0026-E003). There is limited qualifying evidence of functioning oversight: the government generally enforced corruption penalties according to the U.S. Department of State, some investigations and resolutions occurred, and COFECE commissioners were appointed after a Supreme Court order, although the delay itself impaired the regulator’s functioning (BATCH-0004-E015; BATCH-0014-E002). A clean CONEVAL audit and completed internal-control actions demonstrate cooperation by that institution, not López Obrador’s personal cooperation or administration-wide resistance to capture (BATCH-0054-E008).
